trading lanes on the second ledger killed, on the recordFrom the lane ledger as of 30 September 2026.

~170pre-registered hypotheses across two programmes
p ≈ 1.0deflated Sharpe of the best of 3,038 model trials. The honest answer
110paper hypotheses. They died to costs.This is a paper book. No live P&L is claimed. No live book is implied.

In the first programme, about 110 hypotheses produced nine real anomalies. None were bigger than the cost of trading them.

~110hypotheses tested: equities, ETFs, Polymarket, factors, filings
9produced a real, measurable anomaly
0survived their own trading costs
Every trading lane on the second ledger, by verdict (n = 65)
50killed. Negative out of sample, eaten by fees, no capacity, or the wrong sign.
8inconclusive. Too few independent events to decide. Said so rather than guessing.
3accruing. Forward paper tests with a sealed sample-size target.
2candidates, on paper. The unlock short below, and the book that combines the event shorts.Both are candidates on paper, not results.
2in live execution tests. The listing short and a Solana microstructure strategy, each at tiny size to measure real fills against paper. Scaling up needs a separate, pre-registered live test.~£0. Live tests run at tiny size to measure real fills against paper; paper and backtest numbers are labelled as such throughout.

EdgeEaten by
Polymarket longshot bias, real: ~2¢the spread is 1.5–3¢
Dip-buying, 503 stocks + 90 ETFs: +20bp in 2016–21+2bp in 2021–26, below costs
Polymarket liquidity provision, liquid markets−$102.59/day per $1,000 (paper), after rewards
Following analyst upgradesthe whole reaction is in the untradeable gap

  • Claimed Buying a newly migrated token 1–2 seconds after the snipers had positive expected value.
  • Caught An audit of the raw data found 88 of 1,320 tick files were sparse.
  • Corrected On the 1,232 complete pools, entry loses at every delay: −5.2% a trade at 1 s (t −5.3), −3.9% at 5 s, −5.4% at 22 s (t −8.6). Verdict: RED, published the same day.

Separately, the meme-desk auditor has closed about 70 entry and exit variants as failed or inconclusive, with no pass standing.
